The '''Ornate Lamp''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that provides light at night. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|1050}}.

It is also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

Players who select a [[Farm Maps|Wilderness farm map]] during character creation will have one inside their house when the game begins.
